comment: Per-landmark hints for the painter, keyed by the slug in pipeline/landmarks.json. A window (1024 model px, about 300 m) that contains a landmark's pin gets its hint after the base prompt (day.txt). Describe what is seen from above and the south-east: shapes, materials, colours. Keep each hint to one or two sentences; edit and send a pull request. A landmark with no hint is painted from the base prompt alone.

hints.golestan-palace: Golestan Palace: a long garden courtyard with a central pool and flower beds, low palace wings faced with colourful Qajar tilework, the open Marble Throne iwan, and the tall Shams-ol-Emareh with its twin towers.
hints.shams-ol-emareh: Shams-ol-Emareh: a tall Qajar pavilion with two slender towers topped by small kiosks, its facade covered in tile panels and arched windows.
hints.iwan-of-marble-throne: The Marble Throne iwan: a deep open hall with mirror work behind two twisted columns, facing a long pool.
hints.tehran-grand-bazaar: The Grand Bazaar: a dense maze of long brick-vaulted roofs, each vault crowned by a small domed skylight, with caravanserai courtyards between them.
hints.grand-chahar-suq: The bazaar's great crossing: a tall brick dome over the meeting of two vaulted bazaar lanes.
hints.imam-mosque-bazaar: The Imam (Shah) Mosque in the bazaar: a large courtyard with a pool, four iwans with turquoise and yellow tile, a tiled dome and minarets.
hints.jameh-mosque-of-tehran: The old Jameh Mosque: a brick courtyard mosque with tiled iwans, tucked in among the bazaar roofs.
hints.toopkhaneh-square: Toopkhaneh (Imam Khomeini) Square: a wide paved square with a round central fountain and pool, framed by early twentieth-century buildings.
hints.arg-square: Arg Square: an open paved square next to the palace grounds.
hints.sabzeh-meydan: Sabzeh Meydan: a small paved square at the bazaar's northern entrance, with a tiled gateway into the vaulted lanes.
hints.baharestan-square: Baharestan Square: an open square with a garden and a statue in its middle.
hints.national-garden-gate: The National Garden gate (Bagh-e Melli): a tall Qajar gateway with tile panels and a brick arch, leading into a tree-lined avenue.
hints.national-garden: The old government quarter round the National Garden: stately early twentieth-century stone and brick buildings with regular windows, among plane trees and gardens.
hints.ministry-of-foreign-affairs: The old Ministry of Foreign Affairs: a grand brick and stone building with colonnades, set in a garden.
hints.malek-national-museum: The Malek museum and library: a brick courtyard house with trees, inside the National Garden quarter.
hints.national-museum-of-iran: The National Museum of Iran: a brick building with a tall arched entrance modelled on a Sasanian iwan.
hints.masoudieh-palace: Masoudieh Palace: Qajar pavilions with tiled facades around a garden courtyard with pools and tall plane trees.
hints.lalehzar-street: Lalehzar Street: a narrow, busy old shopping street lined with two- and three-storey buildings.
hints.baharestan-mansion: Baharestan: the old parliament building with a garden in front.
hints.sepahsalar-mosque: Sepahsalar Mosque and school: a large courtyard with a pool, four tiled iwans, a big tiled dome and eight minarets.
hints.dar-ul-funun: Dar ul-Funun: a two-storey brick school building with arched windows around a courtyard with trees.
hints.imperial-bank-building: The old Imperial Bank: a brick building with tile panels and arched windows.
hints.ebrat-museum: The Ebrat museum: a round brick building around a circular courtyard.
hints.abgineh-museum: The Abgineh (glass) museum: a small pavilion in a walled garden with trees.
hints.tehran-courthouse: The old courthouse: a large brick building with arched windows.
hints.city-park: City Park (Park-e Shahr): a large park with lawns, a lake, paths and many trees.
hints.arsenal-gate: The Arsenal gateway: a Qajar gate with a brick arch and tile panels.
hints.tekyeh-dowlat-site: Where the Tekyeh Dowlat stood: today an ordinary built-up block.
hints.saint-mary-church: Saint Mary's Armenian church: a small church with a drum and pointed dome, in a walled yard.
hints.thaddeus-bartholomew-church: The church of Thaddeus and Bartholomew: a small Armenian church with a bell tower, in a walled yard.
hints.bank-melli-water-tower: The old water tower: a slender tower standing above the roofs around it.
hints.hasan-abad-square: Hasan Abad Square: a round square framed by four matching domed corner buildings.
